preconditions.description: The input contains at least two lines: the user's name and the number of actions.

preconditions.expression: lines[0].strip() == lines[0] and len(lines[0]) >= 1 and len(lines[0]) <= 10 and lines[0].islower() and lines[0].isalpha()
preconditions.description: The first line is the user's name, consisting of 1 to 10 lowercase Latin letters with no surrounding whitespace.
The second line is an integer n between 1 and 100 inclusive.
The total number of lines matches the declared number of actions plus the header lines.

preconditions.expression: all(' ' in line and line.count(' ') >= 3 for line in lines[2:])
preconditions.description: Each action line contains spaces separating words, implying a structure of at least 4 tokens.

postconditions.description: The number of output lines equals the number of distinct names found in the actions, excluding the user.
The set of names in the output exactly matches the set of distinct names appearing in the actions, excluding the user.

postconditions.expression: all(priority_scores[output_lines[i]] >= priority_scores[output_lines[i+1]] for i in range(len(output_lines)-1))
postconditions.description: The output names are sorted in descending order of their calculated priority factor with the user.

postconditions.expression: all((priority_scores[output_lines[i]] > priority_scores[output_lines[i+1]]) or (priority_scores[output_lines[i]] == priority_scores[output_lines[i+1]] and output_lines[i] < output_lines[i+1]) for i in range(len(output_lines)-1))
postconditions.description: For names with equal priority factors, they are sorted in ascending lexicographical order.

postconditions.expression: all(name in output_lines for name in distinct_others)
postconditions.description: Every distinct name found in the input (excluding the user) appears exactly once in the output, even if their priority is zero.
